items.question: What is Lotto Agent?
items.answer: Lotto Agent is an online lottery courier founded in 2012. It purchases official tickets from retailers, scans them, and uploads images to your account—similar to other ticket agents, with a focus on straightforward courier service rather than casino extras.

items.question: Is Lotto Agent legit?
items.answer: Lotto Agent has operated publicly for many years with scanned-ticket proof for orders. As with any courier, verify game availability for your country, read fee disclosures at checkout, and complete KYC before requesting withdrawals.

items.question: How does the Lotto Agent app work?
items.answer: The mobile app mirrors the website: fund your wallet, choose draws, and view scans on your phone. Download from official sources only. Push notifications can alert you to results if enabled in settings.

items.question: What is the Lotto Agent commission or fee?
items.answer: Lotto Agent charges service fees on top of face-value ticket prices to cover retail purchase, scanning, and support. There is no separate hidden commission on winnings, but currency conversion may add cost—review the checkout total in your currency.

items.question: How do Lotto Agent login and results work?
items.answer: Log in with your registered email and password. Open order history to see scans and matched results after draws. If a scan is missing near cutoff, contact support with your order number instead of buying duplicate tickets.

items.question: Is Lotto Agent the same as a retail lotto agent near me?
items.answer: No. Search suggestions about “lotto agent near me” usually refer to physical convenience-store clerks. Lotto Agent the website is an international courier service—you do not visit a local shop; staff abroad buy tickets on your behalf.
